editorial:
Imagine you are already fighting with your spouse and your marriage feels like it is falling apart. Now, imagine a random young man knocks on your door claiming he is your grandson from a daughter you never knew you had. That is exactly the mess these two characters find themselves in. It starts off feeling like a quirky comedy about an awkward family reunion, but it quickly turns into something much more suspicious. You will find yourself wondering if this kid is actually related to them or if he is just a very clever scammer looking for a free place to stay and some easy money.

What really makes this work is the acting, as the chemistry between the older couple and the grandson feels very real and tense. The movie does a great job of switching between being funny and making you feel uneasy. While the middle part drags a little bit, the payoff is worth it. If you want a cozy but mysterious night in, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call so you can rewatch the clues.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that the grandson is a total fraud who tricked the couple to steal their money. He is a professional con artist who targets lonely people. However, the couple finds out the truth before he can get away with everything. In the end, the lies catch up to him, and he is exposed. The couple actually finds a way to heal their own relationship through the chaos he caused, ending the movie on a hopeful note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family mysteries and clever scams.
